name: IM-2 Athena
intro: Hello! I'm Athena, Odie's sister. I carry a drill to look for ice.
Target: Mons Mouton, a flat-topped mountain near the south pole.
Shadows there are LONG and the light is tricky.
Choose carefully. My altimeter is feeling a bit noisy today.
briefing: My altimeter readings are jumping around...
fact: Athena landed in a crater on its side, so its mission ended early: the south pole is hard!

alarm.title: Noisy Altimeter
alarm.briefing: My altimeter is giving noisy readings and I'm not sure where I am! Choose the landing site, carefully!
